info.title: EU Data Act API
info.description: M2M and Telemetry APIs for the EU Data Act Developer Portal Sandbox.

tags.name: Charging settings
tags.description: Fetch charging settings the owner has configured on the vehicle, including climate timers

BearerAuth.description: Provide the OAuth2 token generated from /token on the m2m API base URL

clientId.description: The client ID obtained from developer portal credentials

clientSecret.description: The client secret obtained from developer portal credentials

scope.description: Optional space-separated OAuth scopes to request for this token. Supported scopes: pdp-telemetry/availability, pdp-telemetry/battery, pdp-telemetry/exterior, pdp-telemetry/health, pdp-telemetry/location, pdp-telemetry/odometer, pdp-telemetry/parkingClimatization, pdp-telemetry/preCleaning, pdp-charging/ampLimit, pdp-charging/chargeLocations, pdp-charging/overrideChargeTimer, pdp-charging/globalChargeTimer, pdp-charging/isAtChargeLocation, pdp-charging/parkingClimateTimer, pdp-charging/targetSoc

get.summary: List the VINs the authenticated caller is authorized to access.

schema.description: Your own user or account ID (as stored in your credential binding).

get.summary: Fetch availability state (availability status, usage mode) for a vehicle.

schema.description: Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) the request targets. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: vin

schema.description: Your own user or account ID (as stored in your credential binding).

parameters.description: Your own user or account ID (as stored in your credential binding).
parameters.name: x-client-id

schema.description: Third-party credentials only. The account (email) whose shared VINs you want to access. The account must belong to the same company domain as the credential. When omitted, VINs are resolved for the account that created the credential.

200.description: availability data successfully retrieved for the vehicle. The vehicle reports each value independently and anything it has not reported is left out of the response, so every field is optional unless marked required.

400.description: Invalid request parameters (for example a malformed VIN path parameter)

403.description: Forbidden: missing required scope or the VIN is not authorized for this caller

404.description: Unknown domain, the domain is served under the other section (telemetry vs charging), or the vehicle has no data for this domain (DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE)

500.description: Internal error while fetching vehicle state
